shots.intent: Capture Demian's desperate leap to perceived safety and the violent realization of the trap as the floor vanishes beneath him.
shots.subject: Demian
shots.continuity_notes: Demian is separated from the seismic hammer and transitions from a horizontal chase to a vertical, uncontrolled plunge into the darkness.
shots.performance: Demian's facial expression contorts from exhausted determination into sheer, wide-eyed panic. He flails instinctively, letting out a raw, ragged scream of absolute helplessness. Y.D.'s voice echoes down the shaft, perfectly timed with his fall, dripping with sadistic glee: "Watch your step, Senpai! It's a long way down to reality!"
shots.blocking: Camera tracks tightly with Demian in a motivated handheld shot as he sprints through the warped, neon-lit jungle, the beast crashing behind him. Spotting a glitching section of floor revealing white tiles, he leaps toward it. As his boots hit the tiles, the heavy mechanical servos engage and the floor rapidly retracts. The camera tilts rapidly down, staying locked on Demian as he plunges into the dark, open shaft. He drops the seismic hammer in sudden panic, flailing, while the massive jaws of the corrupted beast snap shut on empty air just inches above his face.
